$comment: Aurora — the 7Solutions naming standard. Point a project at this with { "extends": "aurora" } and override only what that project genuinely differs on (normally just figma.fileKey and code.*). Edit THIS file to change the standard; editing a project's copy makes a second standard.

convention.$comment_aliases: Short forms that show up in older files, mapped to the words the standard uses. Matched on a whole segment.
convention.$comment_conforming: Already correct — reported as conforming and never proposed. This is what makes a run on a healthy file come back almost empty. NOTE: conforming is checked BEFORE rules, so list the exact groups that are right, not the whole namespace — `color/**` here would shadow the `color/bg-*` rule below and nothing would ever be fixed.
convention.$comment_ignore: Out of scope for a rename pass entirely.
convention.$comment_rules: Older shapes seen in real files, mapped onto the standard. First match wins, so these run most-specific first.
convention.$comment_structure: What the standard requires. A proposal that breaks this comes back as needsReview with to:null instead of a guess.
convention.$comment_sizes: spacing/md rather than spacing/4. Switch to "numeric" if the team spells its scale that way.

code.$comment: Defaults only — a project overrides roots/include/generated, and MUST set cssPrefix and flutterPrefix to match its own tokens.config.json.
